classification: After the rank/positive-percentile/negative-percentile/standardized-margin directional guard: POSITIVE_EVIDENCE_DOMINANT if positive advantage > 0.10 and > 2*max(negative advantage,0); NEGATIVE_CONFUSION_DOMINANT if negative advantage > 0.10 and > 2*max(positive advantage,0); MIXED if both > 0.10 and neither dominates by >2x; otherwise AMBIGUOUS. A failed guard is AMBIGUOUS.
required_directional_guard: T0 positive rank better than SAM; T0 positive percentile >= SAM; SAM negative percentile >= T0; T0 standardized margin > SAM

standardized_feature_definitions.negative_suppression_advantage: SAM top-negative z - T0 top-negative z
standardized_feature_definitions.positive_advantage: T0 best-positive z - SAM best-positive z
standardized_feature_definitions.standardized_margin_advantage: T0 standardized margin - SAM standardized margin
